_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Fear & Greed near mid-range with drifting price and unconfirmed bottom analog keep the tape in Anxiety coil with mild downside bias until flows or momentum cleanly reverse.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward is Anxiety/DOWN low conviction; narrative supplies flow color only and does not confirm or refute the phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed breaks below 40 and 30d momentum rolls further negative while ETF flows stay near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: Spot ETF flows rebound and BTC reclaims positive 30d momentum with Fear & Greed holding above 55
